text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with El 
Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We took our time, and now it's completely 
night out, yes~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"We have an early day tomorrow, so 
Trainer, please rest as soon as you get 
home—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aah!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I had homework due tomorrow, YES! I 
completely forgot about it!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And to top it off, I left my handout in 
the classroom... Aaaargh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El, this is the third time you've 
forgotten your homework, yes, it iiis!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I promised the teacher that if I forgot 
next time, I'd have to submit a report…… 
Aaaah……!"
choice_data_list: Let's go pick it up now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!? Are you sure, yes!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude, excitement, thank you so 
muuuuch! Let's go get it right away!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The lights are on, but it's s-so 
dark, *desu*.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way! There is nothing in the world 
that El fears when wearing her mask!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El doesn't believe in ghosts or anything! 
It's just...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I was watching a horror movie 
with Grass and the others, you see...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An old lord wielding a giant axe attacks 
the townsfolk to enact his revenge from 
the past, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And the setting is the school at night...! 
Ugh, I would've been fine if it were just 
ghosts!
choice_data_list: Living ones are scarier to you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Because using moves on a ghost might not 
be a problem, but still...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Using moves on an ordinary person with a 
physical body is strictly forbidden!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Which means I can't fiiiiight! If my 
opponent were a sturdy Umamusume, maybe, 
but not like this!!

It was logic that made sense yet didn't... 
but I chose not to press any further.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, no dilly-dallying! Get to the 
classroom right this instant, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oof... I-It's so dark, desu...

The lights in the hallway leading to the 
classroom were completely switched off...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-I am the strongest Umamusume, El Condor 
Pasa...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There is nothing to be afraid of...!

...Is that really true? She seems awfully 
concerned about her surroundings, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
T-The cowardly El from back then is 
nowhere to be found anymooore, senooor...!
choice_data_list: Yo, the world's strongest and fastest!

There's a figure behind you holding an 
axe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah! T-Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! Dauntless, world's fastest, 
lightning swift!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Its name is El Condor Pasa! DEEEES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter who shows up! They won't be able 
to keep up with El's legs!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if I had to carry you in my arms, 
Trainer, I'd still run all the way through 
to the finish!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thank you very much, Trainer.

For some reason, she seemed all fired up. 
After that, El Condor Pasa safely 
retrieved her handouts and finished her 
homework.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek!? Could it be, Lord Mitsukuni!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not scared! I'm not scared at aaaaall! 
Even if an old lord wielding an axe 
appears...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The strongest in the world is El, 
yeeeeeees!!

El Condor Pasa dashed away at blinding 
speed... but.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!? Where are we, yes!? Trainer-san!?

Panicking, it seems they ended up getting 
lost inside the school...
And after a while—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I'm so exhausted from 
running... that I don't even have the 
energy to be scared... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, please don't just wander off on your 
own again...!"

Without saying "You were the one who 
pulled away—" I simply comforted El Condor 
Pasa.

It seems that somehow, in the most 
unexpected way, it turned into an 
endurance training run.

Afterward, completely exhausted, El Condor 
Pasa still finished her printout properly, 
avoiding the essay.
